question: True or false: with suppressHydrationWarning, React updates the text to the client's value.
say: True or false? With suppress hydration warning, React updates the text to the client's value.
explanation: It only silences the warning. React will not attempt to patch mismatched text content. Use two-pass rendering if the client must show something else.
explainSay: False. It only silences the warning. React won't patch the text.
